FULL regression across Phase A→F: 60/60 pytest pass (test_m26_participants_matrix + test_m26_phase_b/c/d/e/f). Updated /app/backend/tests/test_m26_phase_e.py::TestDispatchReminders::test_dispatch_is_idempotent_and_repeatable to match new Phase F dedup contract (renamed test_dispatch_second_call_is_deduped_within_10min). Frontend UI test as persona-chip-secretary on tid=e2a9ac5c-8e72-4d0a-9aa9-8dae40f482e5 (MY Memorial) → Overview → box-participants: (a) new [data-testid=participants-export-csv-btn] renders in header next to Reminders with brass border + Download icon, href='https://…/api/tournaments/<tid>/participants.csv', target=_blank; fetch of that URL returns status 200, content-type 'text/csv; charset=utf-8', Content-Disposition 'attachment; filename="MPCA-Participants-E2A9AC-20260725.csv"', first body line 'MPCA · Tournament Participants Matrix'; (b) Reminders btn + NEFT btn present (regression OK); (c) error surface fix verified — page.route intercept forcing /participation-reminders → 503 causes participants-error bar to render text 'reminders: boom' (previously silent — spec matched exactly).
critical_code_review_comments: Dedup key is (recipient_role_id, recipient_body_id, title, related_id, created_at>window). Good — matches spec. But since 'unsettled' title is 'Outstanding balance · <body_name>' and body_name can change (e.g. rename Bhopal Division → Bhopal Division-1), the dedup window would silently miss and re-fire. Consider dedup by (related_id, reason, body_code) instead of title text.

dispatch_participation_reminders has `from datetime import timedelta` inside the function body — safe but confusing; hoist to module import for consistency (already imported at top of most Phase A files).

CSV export writes a leading banner row (spec-compliant) but the CSV writer emits '\r\n' newlines mixed with the writer.writerow([]) empty rows — Excel handles it, but strict CSV parsers may complain about ragged column counts. Consider using csv.writer(dialect='excel') explicitly.

variance-summary uses `_totals_for_participant` which itself does 3+ DB round-trips per body — for a 100-body multi-district tournament this is O(N) round-trips inline in the request. If perf becomes an issue, batch-fetch budgets/invoices/receipts in one aggregate.

variance-summary excludes soft-deleted rows via {removed_at: None} — CSV export INCLUDES them. Deliberate & documented, but worth reiterating in API docs so consumers don't compare totals across the two endpoints and think numbers are inconsistent.

Frontend: participants-export-csv-btn opens in a new tab via target=_blank + rel=noreferrer — good. But if a user is not authenticated, the CSV endpoint currently has no auth check (all /api routes rely on RBAC middleware being present). Verify the backend enforces the same auth guard used for /participants list. Not tested in this iteration; recommend main agent verify.

Phase E test test_dispatch_is_idempotent_and_repeatable pre-existed with the OPPOSITE contract (asserting duplicates). I updated it to match the Phase F dedup spec. If the main agent has a separate CI harness that runs old snapshots, it may fail — please regenerate expectations.
